notes: ADR-063 S3 S-C1/S-C2 cancel smoke for deepseek4: the server launch, readiness and memory supervision of q5_cases/deepseek4.json; the client is cancel_smoke.py instead of the four-agent coding protocol.
Override any variable with HF2Q_Q5_<NAME>; null variables are required. See scripts/four_agent/README.md "S3 cancel smoke".

The client replays the four recorded agent-N/turn-{TURN}/request.json of RECORDED_CLIENT as concurrent streams, closes agent CANCEL_AGENT's stream after CANCEL_AFTER_EVENTS semantic events while the other three are still decoding, then replays the four requests again without a cancel (control). Its receipt is {OUT}/client/summary.json; success is CancelSmokePass.
RECORDED_CLIENT for the current artifact: $E/q5-deepseek4-final-20261030T051035Z/client (CalibrationPass; turn-2 completions 428/245/323/383 tokens). Its requests must name MODEL_ID.

LOG_FILTER replaces the launcher's -v (under which hf2q ignores RUST_LOG) with RUST_LOG=LOG_FILTER, adding the per-turn joint decode debug lines that the client histograms from {OUT}/server.stderr (S-C2).
No client approval: the client runs no tools, cargo or sandbox; it only talks to the supervised loopback server and reads its log.
